name: Accordion
blurb: Stacked sections that expand to show their content, one at a time.
mechanism: Native `<details name="…">`. The name attribute makes the group exclusive, so open/close, keyboard, and find-in-page are the browser's job. Zero JavaScript.
caveats: Exclusive mode needs a browser that supports the name attribute; older ones simply allow several panels open at once, which degrades cleanly.
A `<details>` is a disclosure widget, not an ARIA accordion. Screen readers announce "expandable", not "tab 2 of 3" - correct here, but not identical to a scripted accordion.
support: The `name` attribute (exclusive mode) is newer: Chrome and Edge 120, Safari 17.2 (December 2023), Firefox 130 (September 2024).
